messages:
Rumi: quick flag - strict fncall validation was flipped to 100% for canary-omega during the midnight roll; seeing rejects like `SchemaError: response.items expected object got []`.
Alex: Wasn't that supposed to be 1%? :eyes:
Harper: Yep. Someone toggled sampling during the feature job.
OpsBot: deploy/canary-omega applied at 00:02 (build 2026.06.01-00:01).
Rumi: Impact low but noisy: ~0.18% rejects and traces doubled because we capture full bodies on every reject. Customers may see 400s.
Alex: Immediate plan - revert sampling to 1% and set permissive-coerce + legacy fallback for prod routes so callers don't get 400s.
Harper: I'll patch router and add metric tags route_id/model_variant and a small example sampler (1/1000) with PII scrubber.
DashTeam: We'll add fncall/validation dashboard: reject_rate by route, coerced_count, fallback_used, scrubbed example stream. ETA 1h.
OpsBot: incident INC-2026-311 created P2 assigned to Rumi, Harper, Alex.
Alex: Rollback merged; sampling back to 1%. Early checks: rejects ~0.02%, fallback_used ~0.12%, dashboard streaming scrubbed examples.
Rumi: Follow-ups: add deploy linter to prevent accidental sampling >10%, add billing rule to not bill rejected->fallback within 1s, and update canary checklist.
Harper: Filed TASK-771 for adapter fix to return items as object. Adding checklist PR now.
Rumi: Thanks team. If rejects exceed 1% we escalate to P1.
